text: Politely tell my manager I cannot take on the extra project this month because I am already at capacity

raw.subject: Project Capacity Status
raw.body:
Dear [Manager's Name],

Thank you for offering me the opportunity to take on the extra project this month. After reviewing my current workload, I must respectfully inform you that I am currently at full capacity and would not be able to take on additional commitments at this time.

Best regards,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Direct
alternatives.body:
Dear [Manager's Name],

I appreciate you considering me for the additional project. However, due to my existing commitments this month, I am unable to take it on.

Sincerely,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Softer
alternatives.body:
Dear [Manager's Name],

I am grateful for the offer regarding the extra project. At present, my schedule is fully allocated for the month, which means I would not be able to dedicate the necessary time to this new undertaking. Perhaps we can revisit this in a future cycle.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

raw.official_memo: The necessity of deploying the full apparatus of correspondence avoidance was warranted, as the delicate calibration between professional deference and absolute workload adherence requires meticulous bureaucratic framing.

text: Follow up with a recruiter who has not replied in a week, without sounding desperate

raw.subject: Following Up: [Job Title] Application
raw.body:
Dear [Recruiter Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to follow up on my application for the [Job Title] position. I remain very interested in this opportunity and was hoping to inquire about the status of my application. 

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Direct Follow-up
alternatives.body:
Dear [Recruiter Name],

I am writing to check in regarding my application for the [Job Title] role. Could you provide an update on the timeline for the next steps? I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Softer Inquiry
alternatives.body:
Dear [Recruiter Name],

I hope your week is progressing smoothly. I wanted to briefly reiterate my strong interest in the [Job Title] position and see if there is any update regarding the hiring process. Please let me know if there is any further information I can provide on my end.

Thank you,
[Your name]

clarifying_questions: What is the specific job title you applied for?
When did you last communicate with the recruiter?
Do you have the recruiter's name?
raw.official_memo: The necessity of this correspondence arose from the temporal gap exceeding the customary threshold for professional acknowledgment. Such delays, while common in complex hiring matrices, mandate a measured, formalized inquiry to ensure the continuity of the applicant's professional trajectory within the established bureaucratic parameters.

text: Yes to Thursday but I can only stay an hour. I have not seen the budget file.
incoming: Hi, can you come to the planning meeting on Thursday at 2? Also, did you get the budget file I sent last week? And who is covering the front desk while we are in there?

raw.subject: Re: Planning Meeting on Thursday
raw.body:
Dear [Recipient Name],

I can attend the planning meeting on Thursday, but I will only be able to stay for one hour. Regarding the budget file, I have not yet seen it. I also require clarification on who will be covering the front desk during the meeting.

Best regards,
[Your name]
